description: This file defines classes and functions for controlling and managing target machines (including QEMU and remote targets) in a build/test environment. It includes abstract base classes, specific target implementations, and methods for deploying, starting, stopping, and interacting with these targets.

classes.name: BaseTarget
classes.description: An abstract base class for target machines, providing common methods for deployment, starting, stopping, and managing connection with a target.

classes.name: QemuTarget
classes.description: A class representing a QEMU virtual machine target, supporting different image types and providing methods to deploy, start, stop, and interact with QEMU instances.

classes.name: SimpleRemoteTarget
classes.description: A class for managing a remote target machine via SSH, supporting deployment and connection management.

methods.name: BaseTarget.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the base target with variables for connection, IP, datetime, test directory, package name, and logger.

methods.name: BaseTarget.deploy
methods.description: Abstract method to deploy target; implemented differently in subclasses.

methods.name: BaseTarget.start
methods.description: Abstract method to start target; implemented differently in subclasses.

methods.name: BaseTarget.stop
methods.description: Abstract method to stop target.

methods.name: BaseTarget.get_extra_files
methods.description: Class method to get additional files associated with the target.

methods.name: BaseTarget.match_image_fstype
methods.description: Matches supported image filesystem types with those specified in build variables.

methods.name: BaseTarget.get_image_fstype
methods.description: Retrieves the image filesystem type supported by the target.

methods.name: BaseTarget.restart
methods.description: Restarts the target by stopping and then starting again.

methods.name: BaseTarget.run
methods.description: Runs a command on the target connection.

methods.name: BaseTarget.copy_to
methods.description: Copies a file from the host to the target.

methods.name: BaseTarget.copy_from
methods.description: Copies a file from the target to the host.

methods.name: QemuTarget.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a QEMU target, setting up image files and loader variables.

methods.name: QemuTarget.deploy
methods.description: Prepares the QEMU environment and creates necessary symbolic links.

methods.name: QemuTarget.start
methods.description: Starts the QEMU instance, obtains SSH connection if needed.

methods.name: QemuTarget.check
methods.description: Checks if the QEMU instance is still alive.

methods.name: QemuTarget.stop
methods.description: Stops the QEMU instance and cleans up handlers.

methods.name: QemuTarget.restart
methods.description: Restarts the QEMU instance.

methods.name: QemuTarget.run_serial
methods.description: Runs a serial command inside the QEMU target.

methods.name: SimpleRemoteTarget.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a remote target based on IP address, environment variables, and sets up SSH connection.

methods.name: SimpleRemoteTarget.deploy
methods.description: Deploys the remote target (no specific deployment steps here).

methods.name: SimpleRemoteTarget.start
methods.description: Establishes SSH connection to remote target.

methods.name: SimpleRemoteTarget.stop
methods.description: Clears the SSH connection and target info.
